This look covers new and adjusted baseline abilities, refreshed racial Priest spells, Rage and stance updates for Warriors, and talent changes across Discipline, Holy, Shadow, Arms, Fury, and Protection.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives — Hunter and Druid
summary: Answer the call of the wild and take on nature’s many forms in World of Warcraft: Forever. We’re sharing Development Team insights on Hunter and Druid, including how these classes are evolving through talent updates, class-defining abilities, and new ways to play.

title: Choose Your Ruleset in World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is taking a new approach to where and how players begin their journey. Instead of choosing from a long list of realms, players will select a ruleset—Normal, PvP, Roleplaying, or Hardcore—that matches how they want to experience Azeroth. Each option operates as its own large ecosystem for grouping, dungeons, raids, and community, with Hardcore joining the available lineup sometime after launch.

title: WoW: Forever Meet the New Skyborne
summary: The Skyborne—also known as the shen’dorei, or hidden people—are a new playable race in World of Warcraft: Forever. Their journey begins on Zephras Isle, a level 1–12 starting experience that blends classic Warcraft aesthetics with elemental architecture and a story shaped by wind and ancestry. At character creation, you’ll choose whether your Skyborne joins the proud Horde or the noble Alliance.

title: Carve a New Path with World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: Catch up on everything announced for World of Warcraft: Forever during BlizzCon, including a first look at the next chapter for Azeroth and the adventures waiting on the horizon.

title: World of Warcraft®: Forever Escape Together Comes to Toronto
summary: The Horde and the Alliance are pushing their rivalry to the test, and you're invited to watch—and even take part in the adventure!

title: Watch the World of Warcraft Live Q&A Now
summary: The World of Warcraft Q&A is now available to watch, with members from the modern World of Warcraft and WoW Forever development teams answering community questions following the reveals of BlizzCon 2026.

title: Tales Take a Dark Turn in Midnight’s Talebound
summary: Step into Midnight’s Talebound, a PvE action RPG game mode where macabre stories come to life. Venture solo or with friends through eerie tales filled with enemies, bosses, puzzles, treasure, relics, and cosmetic rewards as you confront the terrors waiting beyond Quillgrave.

title: Raise Your Stein! Brewfest Returns with Battle-Brewed Rewards
summary: Eat delicious food, drink bountiful beverages, ride rams around barrels of apples, and earn stout rewards! Brewfest has arrived, and you can enjoy all that and more from September 20 to October 6.

title: Submit Your Questions for the World of Warcraft Live Q&A September 17
summary: Have a question about what you learned at BlizzCon 2026 after the show reveals? We're collecting your questions and hosting a live Q&A with members of the World of Warcraft modern and Forever development teams to answer as many as we can on September 17.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Deep Dive Panel Recap
summary: Missed the World of Warcraft: Forever Deep Dive? Associate Production Director Clay Stone, Senior Game Designer Josh Greenfield, Lead Software Engineer Ana Resendez, and Principal Game Designer Kris Zierhut shared a closer look at the systems shaping the game, including Camping, Legacy System progression, combat updates, and more.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Headlines a Packed WoW Weekly
summary: Get to know World of Warcraft: Forever through our latest articles on choosing your ruleset, naming your character, class and race combinations, the new Skyborne race, and the Legacy System, then watch episode 1 of the World of Warcraft: Forever Podcast. You can also look ahead to October’s Trading Post and catch up on the Brewfest in-game holiday, what’s happening in the WoW Portal Room, and more in WoW Weekly.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever What’s Next Panel Recap
summary: For years, players have wondered what new adventures could still unfold in original Azeroth. During the What’s Next panel, Senior Game Director Ion Hazzikostas, Lead Classic Designer Tim Jones, Lead Software Engineer Nora Mills, and Associate Production Director Clay Stone shared how that dream is taking shape in World of Warcraft: Forever, from new regions and dungeons to raids, systems, the new playable Skyborne race, and the road ahead.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Found Photos Panel Recap
summary: Senior Game Designer Josh Greenfield and Lead Content Designer Evan Lee shared how original Azeroth’s forgotten corners, unfinished threads, and long-held player memories helped inspire World of Warcraft: Forever. Learn how the team is expanding the level 1–60 experience with reimagined regions, quests, characters, locations, and stories that build on original Azeroth.

title: Blizzcon 2026, WoW Forever Beta, Midnight S3, and More in This Week’s Wow Weekly
summary: This week’s WoW Weekly roundup spotlights BlizzCon 2026 and the latest World of Warcraft announcements, including World of Warcraft: Forever, answers to community questions from our modern WoW and WoW Forever live Q&A, a peek at the Midnight Season 3 Dungeon pool, and more!

title: Create the Hero You Want to Be in World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: Explore the playable races, class combinations, and updated racial traits coming in World of Warcraft: Forever, including new options for familiar favorites along with the introduction of the Skyborne.

title: Watch the World of Warcraft: Forever Podcast, Ep. 1
summary: Join Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield, Lead Classic Designer Tim Jones, and content creators Countdown To Classic and Xaryu in the first episode of the World of Warcraft: Forever Podcast.

title: The World of Warcraft: Forever Beta Now Live
summary: The World of Warcraft: Forever beta begins September 17 and is available through October 21. Opt in for a chance to join testing, or gain beta access by purchasing eligible World of Warcraft: Forever bundles, then share your feedback as we prepare for launch on November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST.

title: Create a Name of Your Own in WoW: Forever
summary: In World of Warcraft: Forever, every character name is an opportunity to express yourself and establish your identity in Azeroth. With the addition of two names, players have more room to create something personal while keeping each full name unique within a region. That means you may still be able to use the same first name as another character, but your complete two-name combination is unique to you.

title: 12.1.5 Content Update Notes
summary: Read all the changes that are coming in the 12.1.5 content update.

title: Take a Dip into the Midnight Season 3 Dungeon Pool Preview
summary: During the Midnight: What’s Next Panel at BlizzCon 2026, players got an early look at Season 3 and what lies ahead including new seasonal dungeons. To take things a bit further, the development team has provided even more insight on what kinds of changes are planned for these dungeons and the next steps leading up to the Public Test later on.

title: Midnight’s 12.1.5 Content Update Arrives October 13
summary: Midnight’s 12.1.5 content update brings the Labyrinth of Kindo’jan—a massive nine-chamber Delve-like challenge, a new single-boss raid, Season 2's mid-season refresh, the dramatic conclusion to the saga of Quel’Thalas and Zul’Aman, Aqir Invasions, and more.

title: Get to Know the World of Warcraft: Forever Legacy System
summary: Explore the Legacy System in World of Warcraft: Forever, an account-wide progression system that lets you complete challenges, earn Legacy Points, unlock character-specific perks, and collect cosmetic rewards as you adventure across Azeroth.

title: WoW: Forever Classes Take Center Stage in This Week’s Wow Weekly
summary: A new week brings even more to discover across World of Warcraft. Explore the latest WoW: Forever class spotlights featuring the Hunter, Druid, Priest, and Warrior, and tune in for episode 2 of the WoW: Forever Podcast. Then, see what’s on the horizon for Midnight with the 12.1.5 content update. Discover it all in this week’s WoW Weekly.
